$comment: OBJECTS THE POSTGRESQL CAPABILITY AUTHORITY NAMES. Declared HERE, in the backend, and not in field-ops-app-vite/src/access/policyObjectRegistry.js, because a frontend catalog may not author the canonical Object <- action mapping (Owner ruling). Each exists because a row in eos_policy.capabilities points at it: migration 1761350400000 makes object_key NOT NULL, so a capability cannot name an Object the catalog does not define. None carries a field; they are security subjects, not data shapes.

objects.label: Principal
objects.description: The security actor: the authenticated identity that holds Security Roles and, through them, capabilities. NEVER the Employee -- an Employee is a workforce record and may exist with no Principal at all. Linked by eos_policy.employee_principal_links.

objects.label: Cycle Count
objects.description: A counting sheet over stock at a location, from creation through submit, reconcile and close. Governed by eos_ops.cycle_count_sheets.

objects.label: Data Import
objects.description: An administrative import batch that turns an approved preview into governed EOS records. NONPRODUCTION-ONLY tooling; its retirement is tracked separately and this registration does not endorse a production path.

objects.label: Workflow
objects.description: A governed workflow and its versions, steps, actions and Role bindings. Steps, actions and bindings are version-scoped sub-entities, not Objects of their own.

objects.label: Report Definition
objects.description: A saved report definition: what it selects and how it is shaped. Registered by migration 1762300800000 as Reporting Slice 1, mirroring workflowDefinition -- a security subject with no data shape of its own. It carries NO field dimension: eos_policy.capabilities has object_key NOT NULL, UNIQUE (object_key, action_key) and no field column, so the 34 field-level report ids are NOT capability rows. Which fields a definition may show belongs to eos_policy.role_field_permission_overrides.

objects.label: Workflow Instance
objects.description: One running workflow over one business record, pinned to the version it began under. Registered as a governed Object; it has NO capability yet, because execution security must be designed together with target-Object enforcement rather than back-filled to populate a matrix.
